description: Use this when the person wants to book or reserve a robot from MERA RENT (with a MERA operator, for an event in Europe) for a date. Returns a deep link that opens the MERA RENT app with the robot and date chosen, a short share link with a preview card, the booking steps and the list of robots. Where the host shows apps, a picker lets the person choose the robot, date, hours and city, check the date and open MERA RENT. It books nothing by itself: the person completes the booking in the app (account, form; the date is held for at least 48 hours and MERA confirms within one working day). For a general inquiry without a chosen date use open_inquiry_form.

country.description: Country of the event: ISO 3166 code ("PT") or name in any language.

hours.description: Robot time on site per day: up to 2, 4 or 8 hours (the app prices these packages).

lang.description: Language the person writes in (ISO 639, e.g. "en", "de", "pl"). The MERA RENT app has 24 languages; others get English.

robot.description: Robot id from MERA RENT, e.g. "g1" (Unitree G1), "h2" (Unitree H2), "go2" (Unitree Go2), "edward" (Edward Warchocki) or a catalog model such as "unitree-h1"; start_booking without a robot lists them.

name: start_booking
title: MERA RENT: book a robot
